claims.statement: Under account03/B20 r35's rank<=5 carrier hypotheses and its finite-core branch |H|<=124, if A[H,H] has three absolute eigenvalues >=1/64, then conditioning all outside original coordinates and applying the fixed-dimensional physical theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<25435439. Thus every unpaid r35 finite-core state may additionally be assumed s3_abs(A[H,H])<1/64 while retaining carrier mass >1/20 on H.

For the r34 aligned triangle C,N1,N2 with Delta=s1(Nr)s2(Nr)>0.0014419528160955833, let M1=[C,N1], M2=[C^T,N2], M3=[N1^T,N2^T] and T_a^2=sum_{j>=3}s_j(M_a)^2. Then e3(M_a M_a^T)>=Delta^2 T_a^2. By the marginal-free physical E3 theorem, if any T_a>=tau then ||p_Q||_infinity<=K3(Delta*tau)^(-1/3). At tau=sqrt(F)/256 this is <956.621; otherwise all three literal cuts lie within Frobenius tau of rank two.

In the unpaid three-cut collar, top-two left singular projectors P1,P2,P3 on the three original banks satisfy ||C-P1CP2||F, ||N1-P1N1P3||F, ||N2-P2N2P3||F<2tau and ||P1CP2||F>(127/128)sqrt(F)>0.2362879672. At zero tail the three cross blocks factor through three 2D coefficient planes. This is deterministic geometry only and does not assert projected-coordinate independence.

On the diffuse row-three-volume subbranch of any three-cut collar failure at tau=sqrt(F)/256, historical Theorem D gives ||p_Q||_infinity<896.972 from Z3>=Delta^2 tau^2=1.7993592384885958e-12. Concentrated marginals are covered instead by account03/B20 r34's original-coordinate hub cascade.

first_unpaid_implications.scope: rank<=5 in-plane carrier S0 with s3(S0)>1597/2000 and ||A-S0||op<403/2000; original core |H|<=124 carries >1/20 of one carrier direction; s3_abs(A[H,H])<1/64; arbitrary residual A-S0 and outside couplings retained
